title: Income, Wealth, and Environmental Inequality in the United States
abstract: This paper explores the relationships between air pollution, income, and wealth by combining data from U.S. tax returns between 1979–2016, various measures of air pollution, and sociodemographic information from linked survey and administrative data. In the first year of our data, the relationship between income and ambient pollution levels nationally is approximately zero. However, at every single percentile of the national income distribution, Black individuals are exposed to, on average, higher levels of air pollution than White individuals. By 2016, the relationship between income and air pollution had steepened, primarily for Black individuals, driven by changes in where rich and poor Black individuals live. We utilize quasi-random shocks to income to examine the causal effect of changes in income and wealth on pollution exposure over a five year horizon, finding that these income–pollution elasticities map closely to the values implied by our descriptive patterns. We calculate that Black-White differences in income can explain ∼10 percent of the observed racial gap in air pollution exposure in 2016.
abstract_zh: 本文通过结合1979年至2016年美国纳税申报数据、多种空气污染衡量指标，以及关联的调查与行政数据中的社会人口学信息，探讨了空气污染、收入与财富之间的关系。在数据的第一年，全国范围内收入与环境污染水平之间的关系约为零。然而，在全国收入分布的每一个百分位上，黑人个体平均所暴露的空气污染水平都高于白人个体。到2016年，收入与空气污染之间的关系变得更加陡峭，这主要发生在黑人群体中，其驱动因素是富裕和贫穷黑人居住地点的变化。我们利用收入的准随机冲击，考察了收入和财富变化在五年期内对污染暴露的因果效应，发现这些收入—污染弹性与我们描述性规律所隐含的数值非常接近。我们测算出，2016年黑人与白人之间的收入差距，可以解释观察到的空气污染暴露种族差距中约10%。

title: Misperceptions About Air Pollution: Implications for Willingness to Pay and Environmental Inequality
Is Air Pollution Regulation Too Lenient?
abstract: This paper describes a framework to estimate the marginal cost of air pollution regulation, then applies it to assess whether a large set of existing U.S. air pollution regulations have marginal benefits exceeding their marginal costs. The approach utilizes an important yet under-explored provision of the Clean Air Act requiring new or expanding plants to pay incumbents in the same or neighboring counties to reduce their pollution emissions. These “offset” regulations create several hundred decentralized, local markets for pollution that differ by pollutant and location. Economic theory and empirical tests suggest these market prices reveal information about the marginal cost of abatement for new or expanding firms. We compare estimates of the marginal benefit of abatement from leading air quality models to offset prices. We find that, for most regions and pollutants, the marginal benefits of pollution abatement exceed mean offset prices more than ten-fold. In at least one market, however, estimated marginal benefits are below offset prices.
abstract_zh: 本文提出了一个估算空气污染监管边际成本的框架，并运用该框架评估大量现行美国空气污染监管的边际效益是否超过其边际成本。该方法利用了《清洁空气法》中一项重要但尚未得到充分探讨的条款，该条款要求新建或扩建的工厂向同一县或相邻县的现有企业支付费用，以减少其污染排放。这些“抵消”监管在不同污染物和地点之间，形成了数百个分散的地方性污染权市场。经济理论与实证检验表明，这些市场价格揭示了新建或扩建企业减排的边际成本信息。我们将主要空气质量模型所估算的减排边际效益，与抵消价格进行比较。我们发现，在大多数地区和污染物上，污染减排的边际效益超过平均抵消价格十倍以上。然而，至少在一个市场中，估算的边际效益低于抵消价格。

title: Is the Social Safety Net a Long-Term Investment? Large Scale Evidence from the Food Stamps Program
The Changing Nature of Pollution, Income, and Environmental Inequality in the United States
abstract: This paper uses administrative tax records linked to Census demographic data and high-resolution measures of fine small particulate (PM2.5) exposure to study the evolution of the Black-White pollution exposure gap over the past 40 years. In doing so, we focus on the various ways in which income may have contributed to these changes using a statistical decomposition. We decompose the overall change in the Black-White PM2.5 exposure gap into (1) components that stem from rank-preserving compression in the overall pollution distribution and (2) changes that stem from a reordering of Black and White households within the pollution distribution. We find a significant narrowing of the Black-White PM2.5 exposure gap over this time period that is overwhelmingly driven by rank-preserving changes rather than positional changes. However, the relative positions of Black and White households at the upper end of the pollution distribution have meaningfully shifted in the most recent years.
abstract_zh: 本文利用与人口普查人口统计数据相关联的行政税收记录，以及细颗粒物（PM2.5）暴露的高分辨率测量数据，研究了过去40年间黑人与白人污染暴露差距的演变。在此过程中，我们借助统计分解方法，聚焦于收入可能促成这些变化的各种途径。我们将黑人与白人之间PM2.5暴露差距的总体变化，分解为：（1）源于整体污染分布中保持秩次的压缩的成分；以及（2）源于黑人与白人家庭在污染分布中位置重新排序的变化。我们发现，在这一时期，黑人与白人之间的PM2.5暴露差距显著缩小，而这一缩小绝大多数由保持秩次的变化所驱动，而非位置变化。然而，在近年来，黑人与白人家庭在污染分布高端的相对位置发生了实质性变化。

title: What Caused Racial Disparities in Particulate Exposure to Fall? New Evidence from the Clean Air Act and Satellite-Based Measures of Air Quality
abstract: This project links administrative census microdata to spatially continuous measures of particulate pollution (PM2.5) to first document and then decompose the key drivers of convergence in black-white pollution exposure differences. We use quantile regression to show that a significant portion of the convergence in Black-White exposure is attributable to differential impacts of the Clean Air Act (CAA) in Black and White communities. Areas with larger Black populations saw greater CAA-related declines in PM2.5. We show that the CAA can account for over 60 percent of the racial convergence in PM2.5 pollution exposure in the United States since 2000. (JEL J15, K32, Q51, Q53, Q58)
abstract_zh: 本项目将行政人口普查微观数据与空间连续的颗粒物污染（PM2.5）测度相联系，以首先记录并随后分解黑人与白人之间污染暴露差异趋同的关键驱动因素。我们运用分位数回归表明，黑人与白人暴露差异的趋同中，有相当大的部分可归因于《清洁空气法》（CAA）对黑人社区和白人社区的差异化影响。黑人人口较多的地区，其与《清洁空气法》相关的PM2.5下降幅度更大。我们表明，自2000年以来，《清洁空气法》可以解释美国PM2.5污染暴露中种族趋同的60%以上。（JEL J15, K32, Q51, Q53, Q58）

title: Congestion Pricing, Air Pollution and Children’s Health
abstract: This study examines the effects of a congestion tax in central Stockholm on ambient air pollution and the health of local children. We demonstrate that the tax reduced ambient air pollution by 5–15 percent and the rate of acute asthma attacks among young children. We do not see corresponding changes in accidents or hospitalizations for nonrespiratory conditions. As the change in health was more gradual than the change in pollution, it may take time for the full health effects of changes in pollution to materialize if the mechanism is pollution. Hence, short-run estimates of pollution reduction programs may understate long-run health benefits.
abstract_zh: 本研究考察了斯德哥尔摩市中心拥堵收费对环境空气污染及当地儿童健康的影响。我们证明，该收费使环境空气污染降低了5–15%，并使幼儿急性哮喘发作的比率下降。我们没有发现意外事故或非呼吸系统疾病住院率出现相应变化。由于健康改善的变化比污染变化更为渐进，如果作用机制是污染，那么污染减少的全部健康效应可能需要时间才能显现。因此，污染减排计划的短期估计可能低估了其长期健康效益。

title: Where is Pollution Moving? Environmental Markets and Environmental Justice
abstract: Do US air pollution offset markets disproportionately relocate pollution to or from low-income or minority communities? Concerns about an equal distribution of environmental quality across communities--environmental justice--have growing policy influence. We relate prices and quantities of offset transactions to the demographics of the communities surrounding polluting plants. We find little association of offset prices or offset-induced movements in pollution with the share of a community that is Black or Hispanic or with mean household income. This analysis of 12 prominent offset markets suggests that they do not substantially increase or decrease the equity of environmental outcomes.
abstract_zh: 美国的空气污染抵消市场是否不成比例地将污染转移到低收入社区或少数族裔社区，或将污染从这些社区转出？对于环境质量在不同社区之间公平分配——即环境正义——的关切，正日益对政策产生影响。我们将抵消交易的价格和数量，与污染工厂周边社区的人口特征联系起来。我们发现，抵消价格或抵消所引起的污染转移，与社区中黑人或西班牙裔人口比例以及平均家庭收入之间几乎没有关联。对12个主要抵消市场的分析表明，它们并未显著提高或降低环境结果的公平性。

title: Climate Policy, Environmental Justice, and Local Air Pollution
Energy Cost Pass-Through in U.S. Manufacturing: Estimates and Implications for Carbon Taxes
abstract: We study how changes in energy input costs for U.S. manufacturers affect the relative welfare of manufacturing producers and consumers (i.e., incidence).We also develop a methodology to estimate the incidence of input taxes which accounts for incomplete pass-through, imperfect competition, and substitution amongst inputs. For the several industries we study, 70 percent of energy price-driven changes in input costs get passed through to consumers in the short-to medium-run. The share of the welfare cost that consumers bear is 25-75 percent smaller (and the share producers bear is larger) than models featuring complete pass-through and perfect competition would suggest.
abstract_zh: 我们研究美国制造商能源投入成本的变化，如何影响制造业生产者与消费者的相对福利（即税负归宿）。我们还开发了一种方法，用以估计投入税的归宿，该方法考虑了不完全传导、不完全竞争以及投入品之间的替代。在我们研究的几个行业中，能源价格变动所引起的投入成本变化，在短期至中期内有70%会传导给消费者。消费者承担的福利成本份额，比假设完全传导与完全竞争的模型所显示的要小25%至75%（而生产者承担的份额则更大）。

title: Bringing Satellite-Based Air Quality Estimates Down to Earth
abstract: We use state-of-the-art, satellite-based PM 2.5 data products to assess the extent to which the Environmental Protection Agency's existing, monitor-based measurements over- or underestimate true exposure to PM 2.5 pollution. Treating satellite-based estimates as truth implies a substantial number of “policy errors”--overregulating areas that are in compliance with the air quality standards and under-regulating other areas that appear to be in violation. We investigate the health implications of these apparent errors. We also highlight the importance of accounting for prediction error in satellite-based estimates. Once prediction errors are accounted for, conclusions with regards to “policy errors” become substantially more uncertain.
abstract_zh: 我们利用最先进的卫星PM 2.5数据产品，评估美国环境保护署现有的基于监测站的测量，在多大程度上高估或低估了真实的PM 2.5污染暴露。若将卫星估计视为真值，则会得出大量“政策错误”：对已符合空气质量标准的地区过度规制，而对看似违规的其他地区规制不足。我们考察了这些明显错误的健康含义。我们还强调了在卫星估计中考虑预测误差的重要性。一旦计入预测误差，关于“政策错误”的结论将变得显著更加不确定。

title: The Distribution of Environmental Damages
venue: Review of Environmental Economics and Policy
abstract: Most regulations designed to reduce environmental externalities impose costs on individuals and firms. An active body of research has explored how these costs are disproportionately born by different sectors of the economy and/or across different groups of individuals. However, much less is known about the distributional characteristics of the environmental benefits created by these policies, or conversely, the differences in environmental damages associated with existing environmental externalities. We review this burgeoning literature and develop a simple and general framework for focusing future empirical investigations. We apply our framework to findings related to the economic impact of air pollution, deforestation, and climate, highlighting important areas for future research. A recurring challenge to understanding the distributional effects of environmental damages is distinguishing between cases where (i) populations are exposed to different levels or changes in an environmental good, and (ii) where an incremental change in the environment may have very different implications for some populations. In the latter case, it is often difficult to empirically identify the underlying sources of heterogeneity in marginal damages, as damages may stem from either non-linear and/or heterogeneous damage functions. Nonetheless, understanding the determinants of heterogeneity in environmental benefits and damages is crucial for welfare analysis and policy design.
abstract_zh: 大多数旨在减少环境外部性的监管都会给个人和企业带来成本。一个活跃的研究领域已探讨了这些成本如何不成比例地由经济中的不同部门和/或不同群体个体承担。然而，人们对这些政策所创造的环境效益的分配特征，或者反过来说，与现有环境外部性相关的环境损害差异，了解要少得多。我们回顾了这一迅速发展的文献，并构建了一个简单而通用的框架，以指导未来的实证研究。我们将该框架应用于与空气污染、森林砍伐和气候相关的经济影响研究结果，并突出了未来研究的重要领域。理解环境损害分配效应的一个反复出现的挑战，在于区分以下两种情形：（i）人口所暴露的环境要素水平或其变化不同；以及（ii）环境的增量变化对某些人口可能具有截然不同的含义。在后一种情形中，由于损害可能源于非线性和/或异质性的损害函数，要通过实证方法识别边际损害异质性的根本来源，往往十分困难。尽管如此，理解环境效益与损害异质性的决定因素，对于福利分析和政策设计至关重要。

title: What Do Economists Have to Say About the Clean Air Act 50 Years After the Establishment of the Environmental Protection Agency?
abstract: Air quality in the United States has improved dramatically over the past 50 years in large part due to the introduction of the Clean Air Act and the creation of the Environmental Protection Agency to enforce it. This article is a reflection on the 50-year anniversary of the formation of the Environmental Protection Agency, describing what economic research says about the ways in which the Clean Air Act has shaped our society—in terms of costs, benefits, and important distributional concerns. We conclude with a discussion of how recent changes to both policy and technology present new opportunities for researchers in this area.
abstract_zh: 在过去50年中，美国的空气质量得到了显著改善，这在很大程度上归功于《清洁空气法》的出台以及为执行该法而设立的环境保护署。本文是对环境保护署成立50周年的回顾，描述了经济学研究对《清洁空气法》如何塑造我们的社会——包括在成本、收益以及重要的分配问题方面——所作的论述。文末，我们讨论了近期政策与技术的变化，如何为该领域的研究者带来新的机遇。

title: Regulating Mismeasured Pollution: Implications of Firm Heterogeneity for Environmental Policy
venue: American Economic Review – Papers and Proceedings
abstract: This paper provides the first estimates of within-industry heterogeneity in energy and CO2 productivity for the entire U.S. manufacturing sector. We measure energy and CO2 productivity as output per dollar energy input or per ton CO2 emitted. Three findings emerge. First, within narrowly defined industries, heterogeneity in energy and CO2 productivity across plants is enormous. Second, heterogeneity in energy and CO2 productivity exceeds heterogeneity in most other productivity measures, like labor or total factor productivity. Third, heterogeneity in energy and CO2 productivity has important implications for environmental policies targeting industries rather than plants, including technology standards and carbon border adjustments.
abstract_zh: 本文首次估计了美国整个制造业部门内部，能源和CO2生产率的行业内异质性。我们将能源和CO2生产率分别衡量为每美元能源投入的产出，或每吨CO2排放的产出。研究得出三点发现。第一，在狭义定义的行业内部，各工厂之间能源和CO2生产率的异质性非常巨大。第二，能源和CO2生产率的异质性超过了大多数其他生产率指标（如劳动生产率或全要素生产率）的异质性。第三，能源和CO2生产率的异质性对以行业而非工厂为目标的环境政策具有重要含义，包括技术标准和碳边境调节。

title: Why is Pollution from U.S. Manufacturing Declining? The Roles of Environmental Regulation, Productivity, and Trade
abstract: Between 1990 and 2008, air pollution emissions from U.S. manufacturing fell by 60 percent despite a substantial increase in manufacturing output. We show that these emissions reductions are primarily driven by within-product changes in emissions intensity rather than changes in output or in the composition of products produced. We then develop and estimate a quantitative model linking trade with the environment to better understand the economic forces driving these changes. Our estimates suggest that the implicit pollution tax that manufacturers face doubled between 1990 and 2008. These changes in environmental regulation, rather than changes in productivity and trade, account for most of the emissions reductions.
abstract_zh: 1990年至2008年间，尽管美国制造业产出大幅增长，但其空气污染排放仍下降了60%。我们表明，这些减排主要源于同一产品内部排放强度的变化，而非产出规模或产品构成的变化。随后，我们构建并估计了一个将贸易与环境联系起来的定量模型，以更好地理解驱动这些变化的经济力量。我们的估计表明，1990年至2008年间，制造商面临的隐性污染税翻了一番。正是环境监管的这些变化，而非生产率与贸易的变化，解释了大部分的减排。

title: Every Breath You Take – Every Dollar You’ll Make: The Long-Term Consequences of the Clean Air Act of 1970
The Relationship Between Season of Birth, Temperature Exposure, and Later Life Well-Being
venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences

title: Airports, Air Pollution, and Contemporaneous Health
abstract: Airports are some of the largest sources of air pollution in the United States. We demonstrate that daily airport runway congestion contributes significantly to local pollution levels and contemporaneous health of residents living nearby and downwind from airports. Our research design exploits the fact that network delays originating from large airports on the East Coast increase runway congestion in California, which in turn increases daily pollution levels around California airports. Using the component of California air pollution driven by airport congestion, we find that carbon monoxide (CO) leads to significant increases in hospitalization rates for asthma, respiratory, and heart related emergency room admissions that are an order of magnitude larger than conventional estimates: A one standard deviation increase in daily pollution levels leads to an additional $1 million in hospitalization costs for respiratory and heart related admissions for the 6 million individuals living within 10km (6.2 miles) of the 12 largest airports in California. While infants and the elderly are more sensitive to air pollution, we also find significant relationships for the adult population. The health impacts are driven by CO, not NO2 or O3, and occur at levels far below existing EPA mandates. Our results suggest there may be sizable morbidity benefits from lowering the existing CO standard.
abstract_zh: 机场是美国最大的空气污染源之一。我们证明，机场每日的跑道拥堵显著加剧了当地的污染水平，并影响了居住在机场附近及其下风向居民的同期健康状况。我们的研究设计利用了这样一个事实：源自美国东海岸大型机场的网络延误，会增加加利福尼亚州的跑道拥堵，进而提高加州机场周边的每日污染水平。利用由机场拥堵所驱动的那部分加州空气污染，我们发现一氧化碳（CO）会导致哮喘、呼吸系统和心脏相关的急诊入院率显著上升，其幅度比传统估计大一个数量级：对于居住在加州12个最大机场10公里（6.2英里）范围内的600万人口而言，每日污染水平增加一个标准差，将额外导致呼吸和心脏相关入院产生100万美元的住院费用。尽管婴儿和老年人对空气污染更为敏感，我们在成年人口中也发现了显著的关系。健康影响由一氧化碳驱动，而非二氧化氮或臭氧，并且发生在远低于现行美国环境保护署标准的水平上。我们的结果表明，降低现行一氧化碳标准可能带来相当可观的发病率效益。

title: Environmental Health Risks and Housing Values: Evidence from 1600 Toxic Plant Openings and Closings
abstract: Regulatory oversight of toxic emissions from industrial plants and understanding about these emissions' impacts are in their infancy. Applying a research design based on the openings and closings of 1,600 industrial plants to rich data on housing markets and infant health, we find that: toxic air emissions affect air quality only within 1 mile of the plant; plant openings lead to 11 percent declines in housing values within 0.5 mile or a loss of about $4.25 million for these households; and a plant's operation is associated with a roughly 3 percent increase in the probability of low birthweight within 1 mile. (JEL I12, L60, Q52, Q53, Q58, R23, R31)
abstract_zh: 对工业设施有毒排放的监管监督，以及对这些排放影响的认识，仍处于起步阶段。我们以1600家工业设施的开业与关闭为基础设计研究，并结合丰富的住房市场和婴儿健康数据，发现：有毒大气排放仅在工厂1英里范围内影响空气质量；工厂开业导致0.5英里范围内的住房价值下降11%，即这些家庭损失约425万美元；工厂运营与1英里范围内低出生体重概率约3%的上升相关。（JEL I12, L60, Q52, Q53, Q58, R23, R31）

title: The Transitional Costs of Sectoral Reallocation: Evidence From the Clean Air Act and the Workforce
Environmental Regulation and Labor Reallocation: Evidence from the Clean Air Act
venue: American Economic Review: Papers and Proceedings
abstract: This paper uses newly available data on plant level regulatory status linked to the Census Longitudinal Business Database to measure the impact of changes in county level environmental regulations on plant and sector employment levels. Estimates from a variety of specifications suggest a strong connection between changes in environmental regulatory stringency and both employment growth and levels in the affected sectors. The preferred estimates suggest that changes in county level regulatory status due to the 1990 Clean Air Act Amendments reduced the size of the regulated sector by as much as 15 percent in the 10 years following the changes.
abstract_zh: 本文利用新近可得的、与人口普查纵向企业数据库相关联的工厂层面监管状况数据，衡量县级环境监管变化对工厂和行业就业水平的影响。基于多种设定的估计结果表明，环境监管严格程度的变化与受影响行业的就业增长及就业水平之间存在密切联系。偏好的估计结果表明，由于1990年《清洁空气法修正案》导致的县级监管状况变化，使受监管行业的规模在变化后的10年内缩减了多达15%。

title: Traffic Congestion and Infant Health: Evidence from E-ZPass
abstract: We exploit the introduction of electronic toll collection, (E-ZPass), which greatly reduced both traffic congestion and vehicle emissions near highway toll plazas. We show that the introduction of E-ZPass reduced prematurity and low birth weight among mothers within 2 kilometers (km) of a toll plaza by 10.8 percent and 11.8 percent, respectively, relative to mothers 2–10 km from a toll plaza. There were no immediate changes in the characteristics of mothers or in housing prices near toll plazas that could explain these changes. The results are robust to many changes in specification and suggest that traffic congestion contributes significantly to poor health among infants. (JEL I12, J13, Q51, Q53, R41)
